hook: Scientists put a rummy-nose tetra into virtual reality with 4 digital fish.

sections.voiceover: Scientists put a rummy-nose tetra into virtual reality with 4 digital fish.
sections.visual_cue: Macro close-up shot of a rummy-nose tetra fish swimming inside a glass bowl, illuminated by glowing projection screens.
sections.sfx_cue: Subtle underwater ambient hum with a soft electronic chime
b_roll: rummy-nose tetra swimming in clear water
digital projection display in physics laboratory

sections.voiceover: In France, Guy Theraulaz projected virtual fish onto bowl walls around a swimming tetra. Which neighbor guided the swimming rummy-nose tetra?
sections.visual_cue: Laboratory setup at CNRS showing circular projection screen surround with moving digital fish patterns.
sections.sfx_cue: Soft water bubbling and quiet keyboard keystrokes
b_roll: computer screen showing fish tracking algorithms

sections.voiceover: Instead of tracking all 4 fish, the tetra ignored almost everything.
sections.visual_cue: High-contrast tracking overlay isolating one specific virtual fish while dimming out the other three virtual fish on screen.
sections.sfx_cue: Pulsing bass pulse with high-frequency electronic shimmer
b_roll: digital tracking vector lines on swimming fish
close-up of red nose tetra shifting direction

sections.voiceover: Researchers at the University of Toulouse discovered the tetra synced movement with 1 influential neighbor. This single pairing guided coordination during 8 1-hour trials.
sections.visual_cue: Data graphic showing trajectory line matching perfectly between the live tetra fish and a single leader virtual fish.
sections.sfx_cue: Rising harmonic tone resolving into warm synthesizer pad
b_roll: trajectories diagram of fish schooling movement
macro shot of fish turning in synchronized motion

sections.voiceover: During November 2026, researchers watched the rummy-nose tetra swim freely inside a bowl.
sections.visual_cue: Wide cinematic shot of a school of rummy-nose tetras moving together in perfect fluid synchronization.
sections.sfx_cue: Deep resonant water swell fading out
b_roll: school of tetra fish in natural aquatic habitat
underwater sunlight rays through clear stream
